# 人员基本信息查询
##### 简要描述

- #### 以T5AI设备为例说明

**说明**
设备端没有实现实际功能，调用接口意义
**请求xml**

```
<PersonInfoParam>
    <GroupID><!-- xs:interger --></GroupID>
    <PersonID><!-- xs:interger --></PersonID>
</PersonInfoParam>
```

**请求xml**

| 字段 |  | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(255, 255, 255)">字段是否有效</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(255, 255, 255)">是否可为空</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(255, 255, 255)">取值范围/长度</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(255, 255, 255)">备注</span> |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | ---- | ------ | ----- | ------- | --- |
| GroupID |  | interger | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">人员唯一标识ID</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  | 默认为0 |
| PersonID |  | interger | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">PersonID，对于添加人员信息时，PersonID默认为0，对于修改人员信息时,使用对应的人员信息PersonID</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  |  |

**响应xml**

```
<PersonInfo>
    <GroupID><!-- xs:interger --></GroupID>
    <PersonID><!-- xs:interger--></PersonID>
    <Name><!-- xs:string(max size:32)--></Name>
    <Sex><!-- xs:string, "male,female" --></Sex>
    <CertificateType><!-- xs:string,"none, passport, IC, custom, other"--></CertificateType>
    <CertificateID><!-- xs:string(max size:32)--></CertificateID>
    <Country><!-- xs:string(max size:32) --></Country>
    <Address><!-- xs:string(max size:64)--></Address>
    <Birthday><!-- xs:string(max size:16) --></Birthday>
    <FaceImageID><!-- xs:string,”1,2,3” --></FaceImageID>
    <ModelState><!-- xs:string;"failed","success" --></ModelState>
    <UniqueID><!-- xs:string(max size:32)--></UniqueID>
    <OrganizationInfo><!-- xs:string(max size:92)--></OrganizationInfo>
    <NoteInfo><!-- xs:string(max size:100)--></NoteInfo>
    <PassPermissionEnable><!-- xs:boolean--></PassPermissionEnable>
    <Password><!-- xs:string(max size:32)--></Password>
    <CardID><!-- xs:string(max size:32)--></CardID>
    <ValidPeriod><!-- xs:string(max size:32)--></ValidPeriod>
</PersonInfo>
```

**响应xml说明**

| 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(255, 255, 255)">字段是否有效</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(255, 255, 255)">是否可为空</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(255, 255, 255)">取值范围/长度</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(255, 255, 255)">备注</span> |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- | ------ | ----- | ------- | --- |
| GroupID | interger | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">人脸库ID，从0开始，最新版本接口该字段暂未使用到</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  |  |
| PersonID | interger | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">PersonID，对于添加人员信息时，PersonID默认为0，对于修改人员信息时,使用对应的人员信息PersonID</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  |  |
| Name | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">姓名，中文字符使用utf-8格式</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">可为空</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">最大长度32</span> |  |
| Sex | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">性别,male,female</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  |  |
| CertificateType | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">证件类型 ；</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(206, 145, 120)">none-无，IC-身份证，passport-护照，other-其他</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  |  |
| CertificateID | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">证件ID</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">可为空</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">最大长度32</span> |  |
| Country | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">国家</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">可为空</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">最大长度32</span> |  |
| Address | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">地址</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">可为空</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">最大长度64</span> |  |
| Birthday | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">生日，格式：YYYYMMDDThhmmss</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">不可为空</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">最大长度16</span> |  |
| FaceImageID | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">图片ID，从0开始递增</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  |  |
| ModelState | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">建模状态；</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(206, 145, 120)">fail</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">-建模失败，</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(206, 145, 120)">success</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">-建模成功，</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(206, 145, 120)">option-</span><span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">其他</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  |  |
| PassPermissionEnable | boolean | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">通行权限使能；false-去使能，true-使能</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  |  |
| ValidPeriod | string | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">通行权限有效期</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  |  |
| <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">FaceVersion</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">interger</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">脸库版本号，从0开始自增</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> |  |  |  |
| <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">Group</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">string</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">脸库名字，格式：YYYYMMDDThhmmss</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">不可为空</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">最大长度32</span> |  |
| <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">FaceUUID</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">string</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">人脸唯一标识ID(人脸识别前抓前比功能使用)，需保证唯一性</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">是</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">不可为空</span> | <span class="colour" style="color:rgb(106, 153, 85)">最大长度64</span> |  |

HTTP/1.0 200 OK

<CertificateID />

 - `/FaceGroup/QueryPersonInfoByPersonID` 

##### 请求方式

- put
